# /// script
# requires-python = "==3.13.*"
# dependencies = ["onnxruntime==1.23.2", "tokenizers==0.22.1", "numpy==2.3.5", "pydantic==2.12.4"]
# ///
# How to run: existing uv runner environment/bin/python query_server.py

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import resource
import sys
import time
from typing import ClassVar, Final
from math import sqrt
from array import array

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, TypeAdapter

from runner import Encoder, MODEL_SHA, ROOT


class Query(BaseModel):
    model_config: ClassVar[ConfigDict] = ConfigDict(frozen=True, strict=True)
    text: str


class VectorRow(BaseModel):
    model_config: ClassVar[ConfigDict] = ConfigDict(frozen=True, strict=True)
    id: str
    body_sha256: str
    vector: tuple[float, ...]


started: Final = time.perf_counter()
assert (
    hashlib.sha256((ROOT / "model_quantized.onnx").read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    == MODEL_SHA
)
rows: Final = TypeAdapter(tuple[VectorRow, ...]).validate_json(
    (ROOT / "vectors.json").read_bytes()
)
assert len(rows) == 22 and all(len(row.vector) == 384 for row in rows)
assert all(
    abs(sqrt(sum(value * value for value in row.vector)) - 1) < 1e-6 for row in rows
)
encoder: Final = Encoder()
print(
    json.dumps(
        {
            "ready": True,
            "startupMs": (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000,
            "peakRssBytes": resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss,
        }
    ),
    flush=True,
)
for line in sys.stdin:
    query = Query.model_validate_json(line)
    query_started = time.perf_counter()
    encoded = encoder.encode(query.text)
    query_vector = array("f")
    query_vector.frombytes(encoded.vector.tobytes())
    scores = [
        sum(left * right for left, right in zip(query_vector, row.vector, strict=True))
        for row in rows
    ]
    order = sorted(
        range(len(rows)), key=lambda index: float(scores[index]), reverse=True
    )
    print(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "ranking": [
                    {"id": rows[int(index)].id, "cosine": float(scores[index])}
                    for index in order
                ],
                "encodeMs": encoded.elapsed_seconds * 1000,
                "encodeAndRankMs": (time.perf_counter() - query_started) * 1000,
                "tokens": encoded.encoded_tokens,
                "tokensBeforeTruncation": encoded.tokens_before_truncation,
                "peakRssBytes": resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss,
            }
        ),
        flush=True,
    )

limits: No production integration. Python/ONNX prototype only; native runtime/distribution on macOS, Linux and Windows remains unproven.
All fixtures are synthetic; this is a fixed regression holdout, not statistical population inference.
No case exercises a nondefault --type selector; the generic union still applies actual native kind semantics, and all22 fixture records are context.

No primary recall rendering was partial, since native complete-body budget omitted both long records before plugin rendering. Separate direct-read diagnostics exercise actual partial/full/hash/read-route behavior without changing v1 gates.
